To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The probability density function of the magnetisation for the two-dimensional XY model is computed in the harmonic approximation.
the magnetization PDF for the 2D XY harmonic model has a Gumbel shape and that this result can be analytically obtained in the thermodynamic limit.
The magnetization probability density of the two dimensional XY harmonic model is explicitly computed as a function of magnetization.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the computation of the PDF of the magnetization in a two dimensional harmonic approximation for the XY model.

the study of the probability density function of the magnetisation of a 2D XY system, in its harmonic approximation, and its comparison with the Gumbel distribution, which has been proposed as a good description for the distribution of the magnetisation in a 2D Ising model in the low temperature phase.
the computation of the PDF of the magnetization of the 2D XY harmonic model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PDF of the magnetization of the 2D XY harmonic model is compatible with the Gumbel distribution in all regimes.
the PDF of the magnetization of the harmonic 2-D XY model is well approximated by a Gumbel function.
the Gumbel distribution is a good approximation of the magnetization PDF in the XY model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the PDF is Gaussian for large volumes in the high temperature regime and that it is Gumbel-like for large volumes and in the low temperature regime, in spite of that the average magnetisation is not an extreme quantity.
the magnetization is a non-extreme random variable in a large range of the parameter space, but it is an extreme one at low temperature.
the PDF is Gumbel-like, in agreement with previous numerical and perturbative computations, but it is not a Gumbel, as it should have been if the average magnetization were an extreme variable.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the harmonic approximation is a very good one, and that the Gumbel shape is a robust prediction of critical phenomena.
the harmonic approximation is very useful in order to understand and to compute the PDF in the low temperature regime.

the harmonic 2d XY model is an excellent candidate for a test bed for the study of the PDF of the magnetization in critical systems, as it is analytically tractable and its magnetization distribution is not an extreme distribution.
